blocks.headline: Compliance & Regulatory Status.
blocks.subtitle: Able Assess meets stringent regulatory and data protection requirements across the US and UK.
blocks.backgroundImageAlt: Therapist reviewing Able Assess results with a patient on a tablet

cards.title: HIPAA and GDPR Compliant
cards.body: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) protects sensitive patient health information in the US. GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) governs the collection and processing of personal data in the UK and EU. The Able Platform meets all HIPAA and GDPR requirements.

cards.title: ISO 27001 Certified
cards.body: ISO 27001 is the international standard for implementing Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). GripAble LTD has been certified against ISO 27001 by the British Standards Institution (BSI).

cards.title: FDA registration & listing (Class 2 exempt)
cards.body: The GripAble Sensor is registered with the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as a Class 2 exempt medical device (Product Codes: LBB / ISD) while the Able Assess software meets all four criteria for Non-Device Clinical Decision Software (CDS).

blocks.heading: Regulatory and compliance detail
blocks.body:
FDA registration and listing

Able Assess is Non-Device Clinical Decision Support Software (CDS). The GripAble Sensor is registered and listed with the U.S. FDA as Class II exempt (not FDA clearance or approval) and utilises an FCC-authorised wireless module (Contains FCC ID: SH6MDBT50Q).

ISO 27001

Able Care holds ISO 27001 certification for its information security management system. This internationally recognized standard requires documented policies, risk assessments and controls covering data confidentiality, integrity and availability. Certification is maintained through annual surveillance audits conducted by an accredited certification body.

HIPAA Alignment

Able Assess is designed to support HIPAA compliance for covered entities and business associates in the United States. Technical safeguards include encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, audit logging and breach notification procedures. We execute Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) with all applicable customers.

GDPR Compliance

For UK and EU customers, Able Care processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the UK Data Protection Act 2018. Data processing agreements are in place with all sub-processors. Data subjects can exercise their rights to access, rectification, erasure and portability through documented procedures.

CDC STEADI Alignment

Able Assess aligns with the CDC STEADI (Stopping Elderly Accidents, Deaths and Injuries) initiative on falls assessment and prevention. The platform supports the recommended multifactorial risk assessment approach, capturing objective functional measures central to falls prevention in older adults.
